defs.def: not guilty of a crime, etc; not having done sth wrong 无辜的；清白的；无罪的

ex.s: They put me in prison, but, in the end, I was proved innocent.
ex.t: 他们把我关进监狱，但最后，我被证明是无辜的。

ex.s: I felt it was my duty to help innocent people who are caught in the middle of these conflicts, so I signed up with the United Nations.
ex.t: 我觉得帮助那些陷入这些冲突中的无辜的人是我的责任，所以我报名参加了联合国。

ex.s: Although it was completely innocent, Claire felt guilty.
ex.t: 虽然这件事完全是无辜的，但克莱尔感到内疚。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, Dorian is surprised to find his wish has come true, after he meets Sybil, an innocent actress who falls in love with him.
ex.t: 不久之后，多里安惊讶地发现他的愿望实现了，他遇到了一个无辜的女演员西比尔，后者爱上了他。

defs.def: suffering harm or being killed because of a crime, war, etc. although not directly involved in it 无辜受害的；成为牺牲品的
having little experience of the world, especially of sexual matters, or of evil or unpleasant things 天真无邪的；纯真的

ex.s: her innocent childhood in the country
ex.t: 她在乡下的天真无邪的童年

ex.s: Its big eyes seem (be) those of an innocent child.
ex.t: 它的大眼睛看起来像一个纯真孩子的眼睛。

defs.def: not intended to cause harm or upset sb 无恶意的；无冒犯之意的

chunks.cn: 一个 无辜的 儿童
责任 去 帮助 无辜的
